title: Saudi Arabian Lentil Stew
description: A hearty and comforting stew originating from Saudi Arabia, made with yellow lentils and flavorful earthy spices.

ingredients.name: earthly spice blend
ingredients.notes: Available at most Middle Eastern markets

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.notes: Vegetable or chicken broth can be used instead

instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and saudi chili peppers and cook for another minute.
Add the yellow lentils, earthly spice blend, arabian coriander, and salt. Stir to combine.
Add the water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30-40 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
Stir in some chopped fresh cilantro or parsley, if desired.
Serve hot, garnished with additional cilantro or parsley, if desired.
